capabilities.justification: The benchmark command emits the replayable core report and validation results to stdout.
The native host runner measures workloads with std::time::Instant.
The optional replay command reads a report file selected by the user.
The optional sidecar writer creates its selected output file with create_new semantics.
The benchmark command writes the guest-boundary sidecar to the selected path.

justification: The command writes its report and sidecar and optionally reads a report for replay.
